name: Đậu Hà Lan
_src: EcoCrop (tolerable 4–30, optimal 10–24); NDSU A1166 (mean 13–18 °C, frost low 20s °F); OSU + Bourgeois 2000 (base 4.4 °C, 667–944 °C·d to fresh pea); Kruger 1973 (phase days); Bueckert 2013/2016 (>28–30 °C abortion); Alberta Agdex 142/561-2 (300–370 mm, 6 mm/d peak); Manitoba (20–25 °C dew); Terletskaya 2022 (RH 80–100 %, 4 d); OSU HYG-3070 (Botrytis RH ≥85 %); Mendel 1866, Dostálová 2005 (outcrossing ≈0)

name: Đậu thơm
_src: Johnny's Sweet Pea Production (13–18 °C, 14–21 d germination, never dry out, powdery mildew); Cornell High Tunnels (cool, yield falls with heat, <25 °F protect, ~90 d to flower); HortScience 37(5):759 [gián tiếp] (night 12–14 °C best, 32/24 °C few flowers); Ross & Murfet 1985 (LD vs day-neutral cultivars); Darwin (selfs before corolla opens)

name: Hoa mõm chó
_src: Munir et al. 2015 Pak J Bot 47:1717 (1/f = 0.00111·T ⇒ Tb 0, ~900 °C·d transplant→flower, ceiling 28 °C, still flowers at 31.8 °C); Munir 2017 (facultative LDP, Tb = 0); MS State P3301 (germ 21–24 °C 7–14 d, groups I–IV, Group IV nights >16 °C); PNW Handbook (rust: wet 6–8 h, 13–21 °C, inhibited >27 °C); Mateu-Andrés & de Paco 2005 (cultivated A. majus self-compatible); bumblebee-opened personate flower

name: Bí ngô mùa hè
photoperiod: day-neutral (ngày dài + nóng làm hoa cái muộn)
emasculateStage: none (bao hoa đực và hoa cái từ chiều hôm trước)
_src: EcoCrop (17–30 opt, 6–40 abs, 40–100 d); OSU (germ min 15.5 °C, opt 21–35 °C); UC ANR [gián tiếp] (18–24 °C best); Craeye 2020 Acta Hort 1294 (ADT >15 °C for male flowers); Univ. Delaware [gián tiếp] (days 32–37 °C + nights 24–26 °C ⇒ female flower/fruit abortion); UGA C993 (25–38 mm/week; flowers drop without insects); NCSU + CDFA + Metos (P. xanthii 20–27 °C, RH ≥50 %, no free water, stops >28 °C day, incubation 3–7 d); Craeye 2020 Acta Hort 1271 (pollen within 3 h); CT AES (8–12 visits); UVM (flower open dawn→noon); SciELO J Seed Sci (seed max quality 49 DAA)
